restoration_note: The teaching enumerates the Living Fire (divine love as cosmic will-substance) at eight discrete stations from the Father's Esse to the visible cosmic signs drawn from sun and moon. The ordinal-formula 'The Nth place which is in him is X' and the recurring 'fire which is set in Y' constrain most fills tightly. Editor restorations of ordinals, the standard 'Land of Light,' 'foundation,' 'wall outside,' 'luminary of the night,' 'these eight places' formula, and the concluding-summary all fit the spiritual arc precisely. Two larger interior lacunae in §4468 (gaps 36-38) describing the seventh fire's relation to the regenerate land remain too damaged to constrain; gap 38 is marked unrestorable.
